items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks about Leonard Feather in the context of Nat Hentoff, but the interviewee (Charles Mingus) does not respond to the question about Feather, instead continuing to talk about Nat Hentoff.

ctx.x: Don't hardly carry much weight now.
You talked about -- you said that Nat Hentoff gave you a lot of good press when you needed it. How about people like Leonard Feather, who were --
Nat Hentoff did what? I wasn't listening.
